# Pattern Bank (TEST FIXTURE)

Illustrative outliers for the test creator's niche. Used so downstream skills
(vid-ideas, vid-framing) have signal to read. Numbers are made up for the eval.

## Own channel outliers

- "Why systems beat hustle" framing: the anti-grind angle consistently
  outperforms tactical how-to on this channel. Reframes effort as a missing
  system. (problem 1)
- "I fired myself from my own business" delegation hook: personal-stakes story
  opens outperform listicles. (problem 2)

## Niche synthesis

- The strongest performers name the trap the viewer is proud of (hustle, being
  the only one who can do it) before offering the fix.
- Pricing content underperforms unless tied to a concrete time or freedom
  outcome, not just "charge more". (problem 3)
